newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's ups Norinchukin Bank strength rating to D+.
newsitem.headline: Moody's ups Norinchukin Bank strength rating to D+.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Monday it had raised its financial strength rating of Japan's Norinchukin Bank Ltd to D+ from E+ and kept the bank's deposit and long-term debt ratings at A1.

Moody's said in a statement that the upgrade was because Norinchukin suffered a disproportionately small loss on its "jusen"-related exposure and its capital would be substantially increased, ultimately bringing its unconsolidated capital ratio above the international regulatory minimum standard.

Moody's added that Norinchukin and the agricultural cooperative credit sector will continue to face challenges in dealing with structural, competitive, and asset-quality issues over the intermediate term.

But Moody's said the A1 long-term rating was supported by the bank's unique and important position as the core bank for the agricultural cooperative system, as well as by the expectation that Norinchukin would receive support in the event of a crisis.
